science_relevance.scientific_problem: Construct large eleven-dimensional kissing configurations of nonoverlapping spheres.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Kissing configurations establish lower bounds in discrete geometry and are related to spherical codes. Each additional validated sphere can strengthen a mathematical packing bound; the local score is not a general AI benchmark metric.

papers.title: Finding Kissing Numbers with Game-theoretic Reinforcement Learning
papers.task_relation: The paper directly constructs kissing configurations to improve kissing-number bounds. This local task fixes dimension eleven and restricts its representation; the paper establishes the primary problem pursued, without implying that its reported improvements occur in dimension eleven.
papers.primary_goal: Discover sphere configurations giving stronger kissing-number lower bounds.

science_relevance.reason: Primary research addresses the underlying problem directly; scientific importance does not rely on the agent/framework paper.
